name: What is the typical process for a kitchen remodel with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a kitchen remodel with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for a kitchen remodel typically starts with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Following this, our team will conduct a site visit to assess your existing space and take measurements. We then move into the design phase, creating preliminary layouts and material selections for your review and feedback. Once a design is approved, we provide a detailed proposal and contract. Construction begins after permits are secured, involving demolition, structural changes if needed, new installations, and finishing touches. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication, ensuring you are informed of progress and any decisions required. We handle all necessary permits for projects in Berkeley, Oakland, and other East Bay cities we serve.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our kitchen remodel process begins with a consultation and site visit, followed by design, proposal, and then construction after permits are secured.
